test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are true about Non-Functional Dimensions (NF) in engineering drawing?

Statement 1: Non-functional Dimensions are shown without limits, as they do not affect the functionality of the component or space.

Statement 2: Non-Functional Dimensions are typically used for reference purposes only, and do not impact the assembly or performance of the component or space.
solution:
The correct answer is __Only statement 2 is true__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Non-functional dimensions__ are used for reference purposes only, meaning they do not affect the functionality, assembly, or performance of the component or space.
 
• They are typically shown without limits and are considered informational rather than critical for the engineering design.
 
• Non-functional dimensions are commonly used to provide additional clarity or context in drawings but are not binding for the manufacturing process.
 
• The statement that non-functional dimensions are shown without limits is incorrect, as the representation can vary depending on the purpose and standards used.
